decls.name: ProPBurnsideBasis
decls.rationale: Proposition 3.3, Burnside basis half: for a finitely generated pro-p group, \(d(G) = \dim_{\mathbb{F}_p} G/\Phi(G)\); the Lean form also records that `G/Φ(G)` is elementary abelian (commutators and p-th powers lie in Φ(G)) and that \(|G/\Phi(G)| = p^d\).
